items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: The first band I played with was Foster Lewis and Dude. Because Roussel, or Bud Roussel was playing bass with them. That was the first band I would play with.

ctx.x: Well, he had a little kazoo made in the form of a cornet. Yeah, yeah. And you could be two blocks away at night and hear that boy blowing that thing and you'd swear that somebody would a trumpet. Yeah, yeah. Well, we formed that little combo and there was nobody to touch us at that time. Well, all during the meantime I was getting my beats together, you understand what I mean? Because a lot of the boys was out on drums, they wasn't getting their beats together, nothing like that. They were just playing mostly for…
Who else was in the band, you remember?

items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: he told me about joining up with him and Foster Lewis... So when they got jobs where we used to take off, you know, get off them nights and go play the job

ctx.x: And after he had heard me, he told me about joining up with him and Foster Lewis. Him and Foster, what they call him, Foster Stan. But it was Foster Stan and his brother dude had their own band. And so when they got jobs where we used to take off, you know, get off them nights and go play the job and come back and finish our work. So he told me, he gave me good advice. He said, you keep up. He said, you got a little, a little bit to learn yet. So after I got married, well, I had given up music because the…
